lxc_bb5819d86567f26e.text: Explore how soccer works and why teamwork matters.

lxc_2dad4857511d808d.text: Meet famous football players from several countries and learn about their achievements.

lxc_52796e8a7f85dc2b.text: Soccer, also called football, is a game between two teams.

lxc_afcfddffc454f676.text: Each team usually has eleven players.

lxc_d2b07ffe4f7a13e3.text: Players move the ball mainly with their feet.

lxc_1fc39c76803e3429.text: They try to put the ball into the other team’s goal, the large net at the end of the field.

lxc_4c7b0ca4a48d72e7.text: The team with more goals wins.

lxc_be13aa3cb3d6f418.text: If both teams have the same score, the result is a draw.

lxc_fdba7266cde26975.text: A normal soccer match has two halves of 45 minutes.

lxc_320c62ba8103eedb.text: The referee can add extra minutes when play stops.

lxc_bed19fc5c0770662.text: Most players cannot touch the ball with their hands or arms.

lxc_9fb65639ca5cc20f.text: The goalkeeper can use their hands inside the penalty area, the large box near the goal.

lxc_2238fc65b4909c88.text: A foul happens when a player breaks a rule, for example by kicking another player instead of the ball.

lxc_700bc3a912dc8732.text: Players have different jobs, called positions.

lxc_431be29a8cf39384.text: Some players change how a position works.

lxc_d12f19a563293f14.text: German goalkeeper Manuel Neuer often moved far from his goal to pass the ball or stop an attack early.

lxc_5fb59db3a9bcd6e5.text: People call this active style a sweeper-keeper style.

lxc_fcaceb00b6303a6f.text: Great players need a strong team.

lxc_8e269595c9811fe6.text: Players pass the ball, move into open spaces, and help one another.

lxc_0b05bebaea4ff982.text: Argentina showed this teamwork at the 2022 FIFA World Cup.

lxc_127aed2ebfddbd71.text: Captain Lionel Messi scored two goals in the final.

lxc_5c786a16d1a79880.text: Goalkeeper Emiliano Martínez also made an important late save.

lxc_d3708b853bb50d84.text: Argentina and France drew 3–3, and Argentina won the penalty shootout.

lxc_2448120d01a52e13.text: One star was important, but the whole team created the victory.

lxc_9d972f28d81b2874.text: Women’s soccer has many famous stars.

lxc_c6a9501827168a33.text: Marta, from Brazil, scored 17 goals in FIFA Women’s World Cup matches, a World Cup record.

lxc_7b19c4f2c1a28511.text: She is known for skillful movement and close control of the ball.

lxc_628fae22b4492cce.text: Homare Sawa captained Japan when the team won the 2011 Women’s World Cup.

lxc_b47be46e17f0e78a.text: She scored five goals in that tournament and received the Golden Boot as its top scorer.

lxc_45a91ea840ea7ae1.text: A player can become famous through skill, records, trophies, and exciting moments.

lxc_5874694e0021da81.text: Brazilian star Pelé won the men’s World Cup three times: in 1958, 1962, and 1970.

lxc_cea1f4048f9a0d40.text: Cristiano Ronaldo of Portugal has won five Ballon d’Or awards, which honor an outstanding player.

lxc_5986d7f5367261df.text: These famous football players have different styles, but both scored many goals and inspired fans around the world.
